company_name: Dalian High Purity Chemical Co., LTD
semiconductor_relevance: High — Dalian High Purity Chemical Co., Ltd specializes in ultra-high purity gas purifiers essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Dalian High Purity Chemical Co., Ltd focuses on the research, development, and manufacturing of ppb-level ultra-high purity gas purifiers, which are critical for semiconductor production. Their products, including hydrogenation catalysts and gas filters, are utilized in various semiconductor production lines, ensuring high-quality gas supply and system management.

regional_presence.China: The company has service points in multiple cities including Dalian, Beijing, Wuhan, Shanghai, Guangdong, Qingdao, and Hefei.
